create_optical_diffuser.ponder.diffuser_: The Optical Diffuser
The Optical Diffuser receives a laser from a Create: Optical source through its back face
…and re-emits it as a shaped cone of light in front
A maximum redstone signal (level 15) immediately shuts off the diffuser as an emergency stop
Without lenses, signals 0–14 do not affect the beam; only signal 15 disables it
Without an incoming beam the diffuser produces no light — it is a receiver, not a source
Coloring the Beam
Without any glass the beam uses the color of the upstream laser source
Stained glass placed between the source and the diffuser tints the beam that color
Glass in front also counts — both sides are scanned up to 12 blocks
Multiple glass colors blend using subtractive optical mixing — just like real filters
The Lens Carousel
The carousel on the left face holds up to 4 lenses — one per 90° slot
Right-click any slot with a lens to install it. Right-click the slot again with an empty hand to retrieve it
The left kinetic shaft rotates the carousel — the slot pointing forward is always active
The left kinetic shaft continuously rotates the carousel — cycling active lenses as it spins
Right-click the front aperture with an empty hand to retrieve the currently active lens
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.lenses_be: By default the diffuser casts a standard 35° light cone
The Focusing Lens narrows the beam into a spotlight — down from 45° to 8° as shaft speed increases
A redstone signal compounds the effect, focusing the beam even tighter for extreme range
Swapping to a Dispersing Lens fans the beam out into a wide floodlight (from 20° up to 70°)
Redstone signal 1–14 widens the cone up to 70° — maximizing coverage for large halls and fields
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.lenses_fo: By default, the diffuser casts a wide 35° cone of light
The Focusing Lens concentrates the beam into a spotlight, narrowing the cone down to 45°
Modulating redstone signal (0 to 14) dynamically tightens the beam from 45° down to 8°
At signal 15, the diffuser completely turns off (redstone cut-off)
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.lenses_di: The Dispersing Lens spreads the beam outwards into a wide floodlight, starting at 20°
Increasing the redstone signal widens the cone up to 70° for maximum room coverage
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.film_reel: The Film Reel block acts as a media server — it downloads and stores a video or audio file from a URL
Right-click to open the GUI. Paste a direct URL and start the upload. The file is saved to the server — no client hosting needed
Break the block to retrieve the Film Reel item. It carries the uploaded media and can be inserted into a diffuser
A comparator next to the Film Reel block outputs a signal proportional to playback progress
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.silent_pr: Hold the Silent Projector Lens and right-click one corner of a screen wall, then Shift+Right-click the opposite corner
Insert the configured lens into the carousel. The lens now knows which screen to project onto
Place a Film Reel block on the right side of the diffuser, or insert a Film Reel item into the internal slot
With an incoming laser and a media source, video plays on the screen. No audio output
Left shaft RPM controls playback speed. Stop the shaft to pause; reverse it to rewind
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.sound_pro: The Sound Projector Lens works identically to the silent version — with audio output enabled
Place a Speaker block anywhere. Right-click the diffuser while holding the Speaker item to link them
Video plays on screen. Audio emits from the Speaker — spatially positioned for an immersive cinema setup
Attach a Display Link to the Film Reel block to show filename and playback state on a Nixie Tube or Train Display
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.speaker.t: The linked Speaker emits audio positionally — players closer to the speaker hear it louder
Shift+Right-click the speaker with an empty hand to unlink it from its diffuser
Breaking the speaker preserves the link in the dropped item — place it again to reconnect instantly
To reset the link permanently: craft the Speaker item with an iron ingot — it becomes a fresh unlinked speaker
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.hologram_: Without an imprinted target the Hologram Lens projects a 3D navigational gyroscope
To set a target: hold any item in your offhand and right-click the lens in your hotbar. The hologram switches to that object
With nothing in offhand, right-click the lens to cycle the projection distance: 2 → 4 → 6 → … → 32 blocks
Right-click while the lens is in your offhand to cycle scale: 0.5× → 1× → 1.5× → 2× → 3×
Hold an item in offhand and right-click the lens again to clear the target — the gyroscope returns
By default, the projected hologram remains stationary
Connecting kinetic rotational power to the diffuser's bottom socket spins the hologram
Rotation speed is directly proportional to shaft RPM — faster power drives faster spin
Imprint a Create Schematic onto the Hologram Lens to project a rotating 3D preview of the entire structure
The structure rotates continuously — driven by the bottom shaft. Useful for planning builds mid-construction
Bottom shaft speed directly controls hologram rotation speed — connect a faster source for faster spin
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.thermal_i: The Thermal Ignition Lens converts the beam into an Archimedes heat ray (28° cone)
Ice and snow melt immediately, and foods on Depots or Belts are roasted
Entities inside the heat cone ignite and suffer continuous burn damage
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.collimato: The Collimator Lens focuses light into an ultra-sharp 2.0° needle laser with extreme range
At 256 RPM, it deals 16.5 damage every 4 ticks ignoring immunity frames — melting a Warden (500 HP) in 6 seconds!
create_optical_diffuser.ponder.lead_glas: At low source speeds (8–32 RPM), the diffuser emits microwaves which cook food, melt snow and ice, and ignite mobs
At high speeds (>128 RPM), it emits lethal Gamma radiation inflicting Wither, Weakness, and heavy radiation damage
Placing Lead Glass in the beam path completely blocks harmful Gamma radiation, rendering the cone safe for personnel
Visible light continues to pass through, allowing safe illumination without radiation hazards
Lead Glass features seamless connected textures, joining into large panoramic windowpanes without internal seams
Ideal for airship observation bridges, radiation containment chambers, and laboratory viewing ports

create_optical_diffuser.ponder.diffuser_: Bottom Shaft & Beam Rotation
By default the diffuser casts a round conical beam
Changing beam polarization at the Optical Source flattens the cone into a wide horizontal fan
Connecting rotational power to the bottom socket spins the beam around its axis
With horizontal polarization, the rotating fan sweeps around like a lighthouse
Rotation speed is proportional to bottom shaft RPM — ideal for searchlights and lighthouses
